verdict.rationale: GlitchTip accepts events from any Sentry-compatible SDK and aims for Sentry API compatibility. Community users confirm the Sentry reporter ecosystem works with it. Its source is open, so the ingestion endpoints can be inspected. However, the evidence shows no GlitchTip-authored specification of the ingestion protocol that a custom client could be built against; it relies on Sentry's protocol and SDKs. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the event-ingestion wire protocol/endpoints, evidence of custom (non-Sentry-SDK) clients sending events, detail on the OTel ingestion path

support.subject: As a developer, the event-ingestion protocol is documented and open enough that custom clients and compatible SDKs can send events without an official SDK

citations.quote: GlitchTip aims to be Sentry API compatible. Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.
See our general SDK setup instructions for getting started with any Sentry-compatible SDK.
Our app is compatible with Sentry client SDKs, but easier to run.
It's also open source, so you can view, modify, and use the code as you see fit.
